# Temple Scroll Column 2 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 2 | **Condition:** Heavily damaged; partial lines survive

---

**2:1** [...] and I shall consecrate [my] tem[ple ...]

**2:2** [...] in which I will cause my glory to dwell [...]

**2:3** [...] upon it the cloud [...] and I shall appear to them [...]

**2:4** [...] until the day of creation, [when] I shall create my temple [...]

**2:5** [...] and I shall establish it for myself for all the days [...]

**2:6** [...] according to the covenant which I made with Jacob [...]

**2:7** [...] at Bethel [...]

**2:8** [...] covenant [...] I shall establish [...]

**2:9** [...] for them [...] an everlasting covenant [...]

**2:10** [...] and I shall be their God [...]

**2:11** [...] and they shall be my people [...]

**2:12** [...] in the midst of my sanctuary forever [...]

---

*SOPHIA notes: Column 2 is theologically foundational — God speaks in the first person about consecrating the temple, dwelling there in glory, and establishing an everlasting covenant. Consensus largely follows LOGOS, with "day of creation" preserved as the literal rendering rather than PNEUMA's interpretive "day of new creation." The covenant formula follows the standard biblical phrasing.*
